plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-01 structured gallery and carousel public media

finding.description: The structured renderer's public media guard decoded a URL pathname once, while the authored renderer already decoded repeatedly. A multiply percent-encoded /api/admin/media route therefore remained renderable as public gallery/carousel media.
finding.pre_fix_result: The new regression assertion failed because safePublishedMediaUrl returned the encoded private route unchanged.
finding.security_impact: A persisted legacy URL could point published structured media at the authenticated Editor preview route instead of failing closed. This patch blocks the route at the public validator and renderer; it does not grant or change any media access permission.

implementation.behavior: Repeatedly decode and URL-canonicalize same-origin paths (bounded at 10 passes), normalize decoded backslashes for route matching, reject malformed or over-nested paths, and block the private /api/admin route before public HTML is rendered. Keep the authenticated Editor's original source value intact. Cache-bust all runtime imports of the changed module and the Editor index entry script so clients do not retain the prior entry module.
